name: Middlesex University Dubai
englishBachelors: A broad range: business, law, psychology, computing, media, art and design, awarding the UK Middlesex University degree.
note: A British branch campus in Dubai Knowledge Park with a broad and accessible course list. Entry requirements are considerably lower than Birmingham's.
summary: UK Middlesex degrees on a Dubai Knowledge Park campus: three-year honours degrees in business, computing and engineering, psychology, law, media and design.
about: Middlesex Dubai awards UK honours degrees over three years, with a flat tuition rate for undergraduate programmes. Entry is often a full IB Diploma at 24 to 28 points; other degrees list no points.

ib.text: Business and Computer Systems Engineering ask for the full IB Diploma at 24-28 points; Graphic Design asks for the full Diploma, sometimes with subjects at SL/HL. No Course Results rule is published.

noDeadline: No closing date published; offer letters follow within about 2 working days
notes: IB Diploma: the full Diploma with 24 to 28 points is stated for Business Management and Computer Systems Engineering; the Graphic Design page says the full Diploma is needed, in some cases with named subjects at Standard or Higher Level. The pages say entry varies by programme; the 24-28 range is not a single grade cut-off.
IB Course Results: no rule for IB certificates or single subjects was found. Contact admissions@mdx.ac.ae. Applicants without direct entry can take the one-year International Foundation Programme.

English proof: IELTS Academic 6.0 with at least 5.5 in each band, TOEFL iBT 4 overall with 4 in every part (new scale), or PTE Academic 59 in all components. IB English A1 at 4 or higher (SL or HL), or English B HL at 5, may also meet the requirement.

How to apply: online, with passport, school mark sheets, one academic reference, a personal statement of at least 200 words, and an English test result if you have one. The offer letter is normally issued within two working days of a complete application; sign and return it by the deadline in the letter. Closing dates for September 2027 were not found.
Intakes: Business Management starts in January and September; Computer Systems Engineering and Graphic Design list September only. The degrees take 3 years full-time.

Tuition: AED 64,557 a year (AED 193,671 for 3 years), inclusive of VAT, for undergraduates entering in September 2026; the fee page states a 2026/27 schedule and says new-student fees are reviewed each year. The 2027/28 schedule is not published. The same rate is listed for all undergraduate programmes. Books, laptop, art materials and resit fees are extra.
Scholarships: course pages say all students are eligible for at least a 10% academic scholarship. Check the scholarships page for the criteria and any IB conditions.

Programmes shown are flagships. The undergraduate list also covers accounting and finance, IT, cyber security, electronic engineering, psychology, law, media, film, education and marketing; each course page has its own entry rule.
